sections.name: Introduction and Goals
sections.template: What the system does, who it is for, and the goals it is measured against.

sections.template: What is fixed before any decision is taken — technical, organisational, legal.

sections.template: The system's boundary, and who and what sits on the other side of it.

sections.name: Solution Strategy
sections.template: The few decisions that shape everything else, and why they were taken.

sections.name: Building Block View
sections.template: The static decomposition: what the system is made of, level by level.

sections.name: Runtime View
sections.template: How the building blocks interact in the scenarios that matter.

sections.name: Deployment View
sections.template: Where the building blocks run, and on what.

sections.name: Cross-cutting Concepts
sections.template: The rules that hold across building blocks rather than inside one.

sections.name: Architecture Decisions
sections.template: The decisions themselves, each linked to the record that states it.

sections.name: Quality Requirements
sections.template: What good looks like, stated so it can be verified.

sections.name: Risks and Technical Debt
sections.template: What is known to be wrong or uncertain, and what it would cost.

sections.name: Glossary
sections.template: The terms this documentation uses, and what each one means here.
